title: Throughput experimentation kit for Dedicated capacity SLA and customer acceptance
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Goal: Deliver a reproducible experimentation kit and acceptance workflow that lets SRE/solutions teams certify Dedicated capacity throughput guarantees for customers. This ticket defines the scope and produces the artifacts: a traffic-generation harness (k6 + Locust variants), a benchmarking methodology doc with configurable knobs (concurrency, arrival process, model mix, prompt-length distribution), and an automated acceptance job that emits a certification report and a per-customer golden-query pass/fail summary. The kit is intended for: 1) internal validation of fleet and autoscaling policies, 2) pre-sale customer acceptance testing (CAT), and 3) periodic SLA re-certification after runtime changes.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible load harness lives in github.com/redwood-inference/dedicated-throughput-kit with CI targets that can run a baseline run in under 90 minutes.

Benchmarking methodology doc (Confluence) describing traffic synthesis, metrics, and statistical tests (p50/p95/p99 latency, tail token latencies, throughput stability, success rate) is published and reviewed by PM and SRE.
Automated acceptance job (GitHub Actions) produces a human-readable certification report and a machine-readable JSON summary that can be ingested by Console test-uploads.
Golden-query set for customer acceptance: at least 200 representative prompts and per-prompt latency thresholds configurable per model and profile.
Integration with Console telemetry: load run creates ephemeral dashboard snapshot URL and artifacts (Prometheus exports, perf traces, KV cache hit-rate stats).
Playbook for customer-facing runs including escalation steps when runs fail to meet SLA (rollback policy, model variant fallback, capacity increase checklist).
tasks: Design traffic models: steady-state throughput, bursty Poisson arrivals, and heavy-tailed spike windows (owner: Marcus).
Implement k6 harness scaffolding and a Locust scenario set that can call streamed and non-streamed endpoints (owner: Priya Rao).
Create benchmarking methodology doc with statistical significance guidance and sample analysis notebooks (owner: Aisha).
Add telemetry hooks: attach run-id to traces, export per-token timing, KV cache hit/miss counters, and concurrency levels (owner: SRE team).
Build GitHub Actions job to run selected benchmarks, upload artifacts to S3, and publish a certification report (owner: Marcus).
Author the customer CAT playbook and checklist; coordinate review with Solutions and Sales Eng (owner: Clara Martinez).
Smoke test on staging Dedicated fleet and iterate on failure modes (owner: eng-oncall rotation).
